column1: # One line per tenant: name and monthly budget in USD. `make local-up` applies it (keys.sh) and
# re-applies it on every start, so edit here and restart the gateway to change a budget. The
# keys are not here: deploy/local/secrets.sh generates one per name into tenant-keys.tsv
# (untracked) and your own into .env as NW_GATEWAY_KEY. A third column sets a key yourself.
# Cohort mode: one line per learner. Solo mode: the `solo` line is enough.
